title: Verification files for residual-dimension obstructions in null-projected SYM
description: Two alternative manuscript layouts for direct submission to Physical Review D or Annals of Physics, with editable source, complete written arguments, supplementary gamma-matrix checks and audit records. Manuscript DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23611588. Necessary conditions under N1–N5 are distinguished from unproved general existence or nonperturbative quantum construction. No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.
